profile.headline: Software Engineer at Moab, CS at University of Toronto
profile.summary:
Hi, I'm Gabriel! I'm a rising fourth-year student studying computer science at the University of Toronto, St. George.

I'm a software engineer at Moab (moab.com), a NYC logistics startup that's raised $16mm in seed and Series A from Elad Gil and Ironspring Ventures. You can read about the company here: https://finance.yahoo.com/news/moab-emerges-stealth-first-modern-143000390.html

You can check out my resume here: https://www.gabe.biz/resume.pdf

You can check out my website at:
https://www.gabe.biz/

You can contact me at:
gabrielezrathompson@gmail.com
thompson@cs.toronto.edu

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
https://moab.com/
Returned to Moab as a full-time SWE. We've raised $16mm in seed & series A from Elad Gil.

company.name: Computer Science Student Union - University of Toronto

positions.title: Student Web Developer Team Lead
positions.description: – One of two leads in team of 14 developers re-designing Next.js-based CSSU website for 5000+ members.

positions.title: Student Web Developer & General Council
positions.description:
Worked on two projects with the student union:
– A Next.js-based website for 400+ students at CSSU orientation and other events, in which users can scan QR codes (updated every 15 seconds) at events booths to log their attendance. I wrote the protocol for generating and validating QR codes using HMAC encryption, and built API for sending QR codes from server to client. Built Tailwind.css front-end for website for orientation leaders and students, back-end in PostgreSQL accessed via Prisma.
– A re-design of the front-end of the hackathon GenAI Genesis’s website with Next.js, Tailwind.css (for use by 300+ attendees), and Figma

honors.title: 1st Place CTF from UofT (1st out of 85 teams), and top 1.8% globally (29th out of 1,550 teams)
honors.description: Won 1st place out of 85 teams at UofT CTF 2026, of all participants from the University of Toronto (and 29th overall out of 1551 teams).

honors.title: 1st Place Overall Winner (out of 54 teams)
honors.description: Built with Zev Godfrey, Barış Bayazıt, and Serena Chen. Our project is a Svelte, TypeScript, and Firebase-based web app that allows people to track local stray cats and see when they were last fed. We won 1st place overall, out of 54 teams, and were awarded $600.

volunteerExperiences.description:
• Individually explain computer science concepts to students as they relate to their coursework
• Help students work on personal projects and other CS-related activities

projects.title: CSSU Orientation website
projects.description: Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and Prisma-based website for 400+ students at September 2024 orientation and other CSSU events. which users can scan QR codes (updated every 15 seconds) at orientation booths to log their attendance. Hosted on Vercel, CI/CD via GitHub Actions.

projects.title: Once Upon a Chat
projects.description: React.js, Next.js, Google Firebase, TypeScript, and Tailwind.css-based website allowing users to upload WhatsApp group chats and get reports on top messagers and top users (it's kind of like Spotify Wrapped, but for WhatsApp). Authentication and database done with Google Firebase, word cloud done with react-wordcloud. Created for UofTHacks 2024.
